proposed_fixes.title: Index localized and English packaged-app display names
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The packaged-app index resolves the display name only for the active Windows display language, so an English alias is absent when the package is shown under a localized resource name.
plan: Locate packaged-app resource resolution in the PowerToys Run Program plugin.
Resolve both the current display-language resource and an English resource from the package resources.pri file, retaining distinct values as searchable aliases.
Keep the localized name for display while indexing both localized and English aliases, with fallback when an English resource is unavailable.
verification: On a non-English Windows installation, verify that Calculator and another packaged app are found by both localized and English names while displaying the localized title.

confidence.rationale: The discussion identifies the resource source and a viable Windows App SDK ResourceManager approach, but package and resource edge cases require implementation validation.
